person: P-018 / DM-X-001, Mihály Demkó, baptised 20 Aug 1882
burials_searched: none: no burial register of the Csicser Greek Catholic parish or of the Roman Catholic parish for Viszoka, 1882 to 1897, is in hand
forward_search: The strips in hand for this couple end in 1882. No later Mihály to György Demkó is in hand; the mother was bearing by January 1857, so a child after 1882 is unlikely.
backward: An earlier Mihály, twin, born 29 May [1873], is marked with a cross (DM-D-013). The 1882 child is itself a reuse of that name. The two are kept as two people.
age_test: The father of 1906 is '24 (huszonnégy) éves' on 23 Aug 1906: born between 24 Aug 1881 and 23 Aug 1882. The child of 19 Aug 1882 fits; the twin of 1873 does not.
cousin_test: The 1906 record names no parents for him. A cousin Mihály born about 1881-82 to János Demkó of Viszoka no. 120 is not excluded by the strips in hand (gap between March 1879 and January 1883).
result: necronym risk: unresolved. Link capped at 70.

rule: X-017 rule on a change of mother's name
person: Children of 'Pál Kocsis' of Solymos: Borbála [1843] (Anna Cservenyák), Borbála [1846] (Mária Jevcsák), Mihály [1847 or 1848] (Anna Cservenyák)
forward_search: The [1846] strip was read again at a larger size; the mother is Mária Jevcsák.
result: The mothers alternate, so this is not a widower's second marriage. Either two men called Pál Kocsis held land at Solymos in the 1840s, or the [1846] entry names the wrong mother. Open. A second Borbála three years after the first is then no evidence that the first had died, if the fathers are two men.

result: Two people. A record of a 'Mária Demkó, daughter of Mihály' from this parish must be placed by date and mother's name before it is given to either. The same holds for the Maria of [1864], aunt of the [1888] child.
